training.tiePreference: linear before RBF; lower C; gamma scale then1 then2; score differences <=1e-12 treated as ties

affinity.method: mean top-three cosine similarities to predicted-class training clips

ruleSelection.limitation: Empirical validation-sample constraints; threshold-selection uncertainty and field-domain shift remain unmeasured.

limitations: Validation constraints are finite curated-sample gates, not reliable-source probabilities or field guarantees.
Wilson intervals omit threshold-selection, uploader dependence, label bias, and recording-domain uncertainty.
The encoder is frozen and may have seen public-source clips during pretraining.
The five broad labels do not establish appliance, facility, location, legal compliance, or harm.
The inspected v1 test set is development evidence; only uploader-disjoint uninspected clips can form a fresh v2 holdout.
This joblib artifact requires Python/sklearn and exact scoring/top-three-affinity logic; it is not a browser-portable SVC export.
Browser feature/model parity and independent field recordings remain required before any promotion.

inferenceContract.prediction: argmax in classOrder; binary decision scores are [-d,d], ties choose first class
inferenceContract.svc: sklearn SVC decision_function_shape='ovr', break_ties=True; scores are not probabilities
inferenceContract.rejection: each predicted class applies its own frozen margin and top-three training-positive cosine thresholds
